evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce MMSkillRisk, to our knowledge the first publicly available benchmark dedicated to end-to-end safety evaluation of image-borne attacks in multimodal skills.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Built from 28 curated clean skills, MMSkillRisk contains 36 attack packages and 108 executable cases spanning five attack objectives, with separate checks for attack success and legitimate-task completion.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Its pooled attack success rate (ASR) reaches 43.1%, exceeding the matched text-carrier baseline by 16.4 percentage points, with higher ASR in all nine configurations.
